description: This file defines an abstract supervisor actor class for managing sharded persistent actors in an Akka-based system. It handles child actor lifecycle management, exponential backoff restart policies, and error handling for entity-specific persistence actors.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceSupervisor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class supervising sharded persistent actors, providing lifecycle management, restart policies, and error handling based on entity ID.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the entity ID this supervisor manages.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Abstract method returning Props for creating the child persistence actor.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to read backoff configuration from system settings.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Abstract method to determine shutdown behavior for the supervisor.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to get an exception builder for reporting unavailability.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Provides the default supervisor strategy; stops children upon failure.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes fields and sets up the child actor at startup, handling errors to become corrupted state if needed.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling for the supervisor, primarily warning during startup.

methods.name: becomeActive
methods.description: Switches the actor to active behavior, handling termination, passivation, and message forwarding.

methods.name: becomeCorrupted
methods.description: Switches the actor to a corrupted state, handling timeout and error responses.

methods.name: passivate
methods.description: Sends a passivation message to parent to shutdown child.

methods.name: startChild
methods.description: Starts the supervised child actor if not already active.

methods.name: childTerminated
methods.description: Handles termination of child actor, calculates restart delay for exponential backoff.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Calculates receive timeout during corrupted state with randomized factor.

methods.name: calculateRestartDelay
methods.description: Determines delay before restarting child actor based on exponential backoff policy.

methods.name: calculateNextBackOff
methods.description: Computes the next backoff duration with bounds.

methods.name: randomize
methods.description: Returns a randomized duration based on a base duration and factor.

methods.name: boundDuration
methods.description: Bounds a given duration within minimum and maximum durations.

methods.name: forwardToChildIfAvailable
methods.description: Forwards messages to child actor or replies with unavailability if child is terminated.

methods.name: replyUnavailableException
methods.description: Replies with an exception indicating unavailability or corruption.

methods.name: warnAboutMessagesDuringStartup
methods.description: Logs warnings for messages received during startup phase.
